energy.title: GPU and relative energy
energy.description: Shows GPU activity and relative energy clues for active processes when the operating system provides them.
energy.collapsedDescription: Inspect graphics load on demand; it is not continuously sampled or used for health decisions.
energy.gpuUnavailable: This platform or hardware does not expose a supported GPU metric.
energy.processUnavailable: This platform does not expose per-process energy impact.
energy.noProcessActivity: This sample found no distinguishable process energy activity.
energy.boundary: These values are relative scores reported by the operating system, not watts or energy. Zero values are omitted; refreshes every 15 seconds while expanded.

title: 應用資源影響
description: CoreRobin 會把輔助程序合併到熟悉的應用名稱下，再彙總 CPU、記憶體和磁碟活動。
systemComponent: 系統元件 · 不建議結束

selected.title: {{name}} 的影響說明
selected.cpu: 當前主要影響來自處理器佔用（{{value}}）。持續偏高時可能導致卡頓、發熱或耗電增加。
selected.memory: 當前主要影響來自記憶體佔用（{{value}}）。只有同時出現記憶體壓力和交換活動時才需要處理。
selected.disk: 當前主要影響來自磁碟活動（{{value}}）。同步、下載或構建任務都可能造成短時讀寫。
selected.balanced: 當前沒有某一項資源特別突出，整體影響較低。
selected.systemSafety: 這是系統元件，不建議直接結束；如有異常請先檢視專業證據。
selected.appSafety: 這是普通應用。CoreRobin 不會自動關閉它，結束操作仍需單獨確認。

uninstall.scanningHint: Checking app bundles, disk usage, and bundle IDs. Larger apps may take a little longer.
uninstall.title: Complete Uninstall Assistant
uninstall.description: Finds the app bundle and leftovers attributed by exact bundle ID. Nothing is handled until you confirm each path.
uninstall.unsupportedTitle: Complete uninstall is not supported on this platform yet
uninstall.unsupportedDescription: The first release supports macOS app bundles. Windows and Linux will follow when equivalent safety checks are available.
uninstall.localOnly: Read locally; the inventory is never uploaded
uninstall.cachedInventory: Showing the local cache from {{time}}; refresh anytime
uninstall.searchPlaceholder: Search name, bundle ID, or path
uninstall.preparingPlan: Verifying app identity and support files…
uninstall.planBoundary: Quit this app first. Only paths proven by the exact bundle ID are listed; app-name guesses are excluded.
uninstall.bundleOnlyBoundary: 此應用程式沒有可驗證的 Bundle ID，因此 CoreRobin 只會移除已由路徑與結構驗證的應用程式套件，不會猜測支援檔案。
uninstall.skippedDescription: These paths did not pass safe file-handle inspection, so the assistant will not touch them.
uninstall.selectDescription: The assistant creates a path-by-path plan before final confirmation.
uninstall.cannotPrepare: A safe plan cannot be created for this application
uninstall.dialogDescription: 逐項檢視應用程式套件與相關資料。移到垃圾桶是可復原的預設選項。
uninstall.outcomeMovedToTrash: Moved {{name}} to Trash; handled {{count}} items and {{size}}. It remains recoverable until Trash is emptied.
uninstall.outcomeDeletedPermanently: 已永久刪除 {{name}}；處理 {{count}} 項並釋放 {{size}}。
uninstall.outcomePartial: The uninstall for {{name}} did not fully finish; handled {{count}} items and {{size}}.

removed.trashDescription: The app has left its original location and can be restored until Trash is emptied. Refresh the inventory to remove this record.
removed.permanentDescription: 應用程式已直接從磁碟刪除，無法從垃圾桶復原。重新整理清單即可移除此記錄。
removed.partial: The application bundle was removed, but some related items could not be handled.

unavailable.generic: 依目前的安全規則，無法解除安裝此應用程式。
unavailable.current_application_protected: CoreRobin cannot uninstall itself while it is running.
unavailable.application_bundle_identifier_missing: The application does not provide a safely verifiable bundle ID.
unavailable.application_bundle_invalid: The application bundle is incomplete or unsupported.
unavailable.application_bundle_not_allowed: Only top-level apps in an Applications folder are supported.

errors.application_identity_changed: The application identity changed. Refresh the inventory and try again.
errors.application_bundle_unavailable: 應用程式目前無法存取，請確認它仍位於原處。
errors.application_artifact_unavailable: An item changed before confirmation. Refresh the uninstall plan.
errors.application_bundle_identifier_missing: The application's bundle ID could not be verified.

safety: 點選應用只會開啟資源證據；任何結束操作仍需單獨確認。
